737080101.text: Hey, a Fungus just floated past. Should it be doing that?

737080102.text: Normally, it's pretty dangerous to have Fungi wandering around the city, right? Unless we're talking about the special cases, the super well-behaved ones that have undergone training...

737080103.text: Now that Paimon thinks about it... Why does this feel so familiar? Haven't we been through something similar before?

737080105.text: That's right! It's Bongo-Head! The Fungi friend we met back in Sumeru!

737080106.text: Woahhh! It's been so, so long since we last saw it! Come on, let's go say hi!

737080108.text: Paimon thinks that's... Bongo-Head? The Fungi friend we met back in Sumeru!

737080109.text: Woahhh! It's been so, so long since we last saw it! Come on, let's go say hi!

737080201.text: Looks like the message was delivered without a hitch.

737080202.text: We meet again, Golden Comet, Silver Companion. It's been a long time.

737080203.text: You're both so radiant and full of life. It feels as though no time has passed at all.

737080205.text: It's really you, Haniyyah and Bongo-Head!

737080206.text: No wonder that message felt so familiar... Guess that means the bond between Paimon and Bongo-Head is still as strong as ever!

737080212.text: I imagined many different ways we might reunite. A grand feast, or a creative welcome ceremony, something that would give you guys a huge surprise.

737080213.text: But in the end, they all felt a little too formal. You've been busy, and I was worried that taking up too much of your time might cause you trouble.

737080214.text: Besides, our Fungi friends prefer a calm and peaceful environment these days. So, let's keep it simple and reunite in a manner that is both relaxed and easygoing.

737080215.text: That's right! The prose that Haniyyah's been reading really paid off. A calm state of mind does wonders for our lives, after all!

737080216.text: At the end of the day, carefree chitchat like this is the greatest joy of all.

737080218.text: Souka's here too! There's also Kindlejoy, and... Who's this?

737080219.text: This is my very own Fungi friend, Stormstress! You and Bongo-Head knocked us out back in the round of 32.

737080220.text: Ehehe, you remember it so well...

737080209.text: It really is Haniyyah and Bongo-Head! We met at the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. They're longtime friends of ours!

737080210.text: Paimon remembers that we saw them near Port Ormos and in the Court of Fontaine afterwards, too. It's been so long already...

737080302.text: The journey was so long, but Paimon really thinks Teticpac Peak here in Scions of the Canopy territory has so much character. For our Fungi friends, this must be completely new!

737080303.text: Paimon brought a few landscape paintings. We can let the Fungi compare the paintings with what they see right in front of them...

737080304.text: They can take a close look, match the scenes up, and then start noticing all the little details they'd normally overlook... If that sparks their interest, then it means this place is perfect for a deeper, longer exploration!

737080309.text: Hehe, when Paimon's got some free time, she reads guidebooks too, studying different sightseeing spots.

737080310.text: That's a must-have skill for any good guide!

737080311.text: Alright, shall we let our Fungi friends try for themselves!

737089901.text: Come to think of it, someone left a message at the Adventurers' Guild asking us to visit a new shop in Bayda Harbor... A new shop in Bayda Harbor?

737089902.text: Who could it be? Paimon's got a feeling something good's waiting for us... Let's go take a look!

737089903.text: Paimon's got a few great places in mind. They'll be brand-new experiences for our Fungi friends!

737089904.text: It's a bit far, but long trips have their own charm... Why don't we start with Natlan?
